title: Rotation Service Records and Pricing — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty
content:
Rotations keep a Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty set wearing evenly and are the documentation the treadwear warranty relies on. The set must be in status active when a rotation is recorded.

The price of the visit depends on the line and on the service performed: a rotation-and-balance visit is charged the line's rotation-and-balance price and a rotation-only visit is charged the line's rotation-only price, where 0.00 means the service is included for the life of the tires. When the line includes a full-size spare in the pattern, the matching full-size spare is moved into the pattern at no extra charge.

| Service on the work order | Price charged |
|---|---|
| Rotation and balance | the line's rotation-and-balance visit price, on every line |
| Rotation only | the line's rotation-only visit price, on every line |

The rotation record carries the odometer from the work order. A rotation performed at another shop is not a Crestline rotation record and is never booked here.

**Example (hypothetical visits):** on a line whose rotation-and-balance price is $0.00, a rotation-and-balance visit is booked at $0.00; a rotation the customer had done at an independent garage is not booked at all.
